headline.purpose: Page titles and primary route headings; keep the weight confident and the copy short.

body.purpose: Everyday records, helper text, and controls where clarity matters more than flourish.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The confident action for saving, logging, and moving a farm workflow forward.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 100ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary), white 20%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring), transparent 50%); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action that keeps the record surface visible.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { appearance: none; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring), transparent 50%); } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A sturdy, touch-friendly field for everyday farm records.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--foreground); font: 600 12px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .025em; } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 16px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease, background 200ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ring); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring), transparent 50%); } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .5; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input), transparent 50%); }

narrative.overview:
Poultry Prophet is a practical field ledger with the warmth of a working coop and the clarity of a farm watchtower. The incumbent interface keeps the record itself in the foreground: a light, paper-like canvas; clear green actions; compact cards; and enough hierarchy to help a manager review what happened without turning the farm into a control-room spectacle.

The system is practical, calm, clear, and trustworthy. It is designed for daily use by handlers with limited technical experience and for focused review by owners and managers. The visual language should stay plainspoken and low-friction: useful grouping, familiar controls, readable status, and restrained decoration. Avoid glossy ag-tech marketing, dense enterprise dashboards, futuristic “AI” styling, decorative farm illustrations, and an excess of scores, badges, or explanatory copy competing with the records.
keyCharacteristics: Light, white-based surfaces with grounded farm greens and a small set of semantic status colors.
Inter used consistently for a direct, highly legible voice.
Thin borders and tonal layering establish grouping; shadows are reserved for meaningful elevation.
Rounded controls and cards support touch use without making the interface playful or ornamental.
Responsive desktop sidebar and mobile bottom navigation keep daily logging close at hand.

rules.name: The Ledger Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use strong contrast for the primary action and important status, but keep most of the screen quiet so the recorded facts remain the visual priority.

rules.name: The Plainspoken Type Rule
rules.body: Prefer short, readable labels and a clear weight step over display treatments, all-caps blocks, or ornamental typography.

rules.name: The Selective Lift Rule
rules.body: Do not make every card float. Use borders and tonal surfaces for ordinary grouping; reserve visible shadows for overlays, active states, and the mobile dock.

dos: Do let batch records, history, and source facts command the hierarchy.
Do use Field Canopy Green for primary actions and active states, keeping it purposeful rather than omnipresent.
Do use thin borders and tonal backgrounds before adding a shadow.
Do keep touch targets around 44px or taller and preserve readable 16px mobile field text.
Do pair status color with a label, icon, or clear text explanation.
Do preserve the calm Field Ledger voice across manager review and handler logging.
donts: Don't turn every card into a floating panel or add decorative elevation without hierarchy.
Don't use glossy ag-tech gradients, futuristic AI motifs, or ornamental farm illustrations as primary interface language.
Don't make badges, scores, indicators, or helper copy compete with the recorded facts.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate offline, warning, error, inventory, or review state.
Don't introduce a new font pairing or unrelated hue family without an explicit redesign decision.
